test_cases.title: Post-login location gate forces address selection before Landing
test_cases.preconditions: Fresh state (clearState); test account <TEST_PHONE> with >1 saved address in public.user_address; SIT.
test_cases.steps:
1. Complete OTP login (<TEST_OTP>).
2. Tap PROCEED on WelcomeScreen.
3. Observe "What's your location?" gate (CHOOSE ADDRESS / ADD ADDRESS).
4. Confirm Landing dishes are NOT shown yet.
5. Tap CHOOSE ADDRESS and pick a saved address.
test_cases.expected: Until an address is selected, LandingScreen does NOT render dishes (location gate). After selecting a saved address, Landing renders "Get It Today" + chef/dish counts for that address.
test_cases.data: phone=${TEST_PHONE}, OTP=${TEST_OTP} (6-digit), chef=Demo Chef (99999), coupon=DEMO100, env=SIT
test_cases.verified_from: Live iOS sim run 2026-06-08 (LANDING_REACHED.png); WelcomeScreen.tsx:33-62 multi-address branch; LandingScreen.tsx:333-338 no-location fallback; screen-flow.md §2.1
test_cases.tags: welcome, onboarding, address, location-gate, auth, P0
test_cases.comments: Discovered while proving auth E2E. Multi-address accounts MUST pick an address post-login before Landing shows; single-address accounts auto-pick (WelcomeScreen.tsx:48). iOS: address rows not text-addressable → point-tap.
test_cases.description: After OTP login a multi-address account hits a location gate that blocks Landing until an address is chosen via CHOOSE ADDRESS. This is the real reason post-login flows could not reach "Get It Today".
